newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's IRI shareholders approve new board.
newsitem.headline: Italy's IRI shareholders approve new board.

text.p: Shareholders in Italian state industrial holding IRI approved the appointment of a new board which will include new chairman Gian Maria Gros-Pietro, an IRI statement said.
The Italian Treasury is IRI's only shareholder and it announced the names for the new board on Sunday ahead of Monday's meeting, including the appointment of Gros-Pietro in place of Michele Tedeschi.
Piero Barucci, Patrizio Bianchi, Piero Gnudi, Mario Draghi, Roberto Tana and Alberto Tripi were all confirmed to the board.
The Treasury said on Sunday the brief for the new board would be to liquidate IRI's assets and wind up the indebted state holding over the next three years.
